subject: Social Media
title: The Data You Leave Behind
description: Learn The Data You Leave Behind in one minute.

hook.text: You die. Your accounts live on. Facebook has 30 million deceased user profiles. The dead outnumber the living soon.

buildup.text: Most platforms have no clear death policy. Your data persists. Your targeted ads continue running into nothing.

discovery.text: By 2100, Facebook will have more dead users than living ones if current trends hold. A digital cemetery.

twist.text: Families fight for access to deceased accounts. Apple once required a court order to unlock a dead son's phone.

climax.text: Digital estate planning barely exists. Most people's data will outlive them with no plan for what happens next.

punchline.text: You log off for the last time. Your data never does.

quiz.question: How many deceased user profiles does Facebook have?
